scenarios.name: Sandbox workload operations
scenarios.summary: A fictional workload operations team reviews bounded sandbox release, recovery, monitoring and infrastructure evidence. A read-only sizing comparison and a finding handoff use the same sandbox workload vocabulary. All examples are authored; no cloud resources or executable environments are provisioned.
glossary_example_vocab: aws lambda update-alias --function-name NAME --name ALIAS --function-version VERSION

assets.title: EC2 sizing: baseline and candidate evidence
assets.description: Read-only authored comparison for a fictional sandbox workload. Current size and smaller candidate are anonymous exercise options, not EC2 instance-type recommendations. Load, measured capacity utilization and response latency are supplied for normal, peak and changing demand. Constraints apply to every period; the current peak reaches the latency boundary, so the low normal sample cannot justify the smaller candidate. No pricing or production-performance claims.

columns.name: size_option
columns.description: Anonymous current or proposed smaller EC2 size option.

columns.name: demand_period
columns.description: Supplied normal, peak or changing-demand observation.

columns.name: load_requests_per_second
columns.description: Observed request load for the comparable test period.

columns.name: capacity_utilization_pct
columns.description: Measured fraction of candidate capacity utilized, not a resource label.

columns.name: response_latency_ms
columns.description: Supplied measured response latency for this period and candidate.

columns.name: max_response_latency_ms
columns.description: Supplied maximum acceptable latency; equality satisfies the bound.

columns.name: max_capacity_utilization_pct
columns.description: Supplied maximum acceptable capacity utilization; equality satisfies the bound.

assets.title: Security finding: evidence and accountable owner
assets.description: One read-only fictional finding and its supplied owner mapping and established escalation path. The observed activity remains a report of suspicious activity, not a conclusion that the resource is compromised. The finding ID is the evidence reference; no live resource or external evidence endpoint is provisioned.

columns.name: severity
columns.description: Severity as reported in the supplied finding.

columns.name: observed_activity
columns.description: Preserved activity description without an unsupported compromise claim.

columns.name: accountable_owner
columns.description: Responsible operational team from the supplied exercise owner mapping.

columns.name: established_escalation_path
columns.description: Supplied escalation route; not a newly invented security conclusion.

rows: Finding reports suspicious activity on the affected resource.
Notify the accountable owner; escalate to the established security on-call if the owner is unavailable.
